name: mask-gated marker scan
summary: Selector 0 inspects the actor lane bitmask against the configured lane count and scans for the next 0x01 marker. Selectors 1 and 2 are marker-aware continuation forms.
operands: payload selector; selector 0 has no scalar operand
control_flow: returns a cursor; selector 0 can skip nested instructions and consume an extra 0x01 marker

name: tracked-player check
summary: Selector 0 executes the body when actor+2687 is nonzero; otherwise it clears the current target index and scans to else/end.
operands: payload selector; selector 0 has no scalar operand
control_flow: conditional nested-body skip with target-clear side effect on false
writes: actor+2612 = 0xFF only when selector is 0 and actor+2687 is zero

variants.summary: check tracked players; clear current target on false

name: target-id marker scan
summary: Selector 0 compares the current and pending 16-bit target identifiers, resets action-selection fields when the target is not accepted, and scans to a 0x03 marker. Selectors 1 and 2 are short forms.
control_flow: selector 0 can skip nested instructions and consume an extra 0x03 marker; selector 1 waits for the marker

name: reset-main-cursor
summary: Clears actor+2576 (main-table index) to 0 and loads main[0][0] through 0x10860340; the lane mask, delay and trigger latch are not touched.
control_flow: returns the selected main script cursor

name: dispatch-action
summary: Reads a three-byte action tuple (group, id, parameter), optionally invokes the action dispatcher, and stores the continuation cursor according to the active continuation flags.
operands: u8 group, u8 action_id, u8 parameter
control_flow: does not return a handler cursor; exits the current dispatch pass after saving continuation

variants.summary: opcode plus group, action id, parameter

name: select-script-target
summary: Sets the current script-selection mode and associated group/index fields. DSL exposes mode 3 as select_target_area(u16), mode 10 as select_target_area(AreaTarget::TargetPlayer), and mode 13 subtypes 0..3 as CurrentOrLargeMonster, LargeMonster, OtherMonster and OtherLargeMonster target strategies. Noncanonical operand bytes remain native.
operands: mode selector followed by mode-specific bytes; mode 3 carries a big-endian u16 id
control_flow: returns a cursor after the mode payload; mode 13 searches up to 40 actor records

variants.summary: mode 10 uses current lane to derive target id

name: main-index-jump
summary: Writes actor+2576 = main_index and clears the stage byte actor+2580, then switches the current dispatch cursor to main[0][main_index] (the state-table entry).
control_flow: direct cursor transfer into the state table; no lane saved cursor is written

name: flag-0 marker gate
summary: Selector 0 returns immediately when actor+1040 (entity status byte) is zero; otherwise it scans to a 0x08 marker. Selector 1 is a marker-aware form.
control_flow: may skip nested instructions until 0x08 subtype 1/2 and decode the marker

name: flag-2 marker gate
summary: Selector 0 returns immediately when actor+1040 (entity status byte) equals 2; otherwise it scans to a 0x09 marker. Selector 1 is a marker-aware form.
control_flow: may skip nested instructions until 0x09 subtype 1/2 and decode the marker

name: set-selection-byte
summary: Copies the payload byte into actor+2088 (byte stored by 0x0a) and advances by two bytes.

name: selection-byte comparison
summary: Selector 0 copies actor+2680 (mind state a) into actor+2600 (mind mirror) and scans when it differs from the payload byte; selector 1 is marker-aware and selector 2 is a short form.
operands: selector plus u8 comparison value in selector 0
control_flow: selector 0 scans to 0x0B subtype 1/2 and may decode subtype 2

name: set/clear selection flags
summary: Sets or clears a family of actor fields selected by the first payload byte. Several cases are additionally gated by actor kind byte+3 and actor+2739 (command mode flag).
operands: two payload bytes; first selects the field family
control_flow: linear field update; no nested-script transfer

name: clear-selection-flags
summary: Clears the same field families handled by 0x0C; the final case also resets actor+2846 (saved motion id) to -1.

name: target-angle/selection gate
summary: For selector 0, compares the current target context against the species/actor context and scans to a 0x0E marker when the condition is not met. The handler also has a normalized target-id fast path.
control_flow: selector 0 may skip nested instructions; selector 1/2 are short marker forms

name: set-script-context
summary: Stores four context bytes, marks the continuation context, and selects a script table entry indexed by payload byte 3 when the table is available.
operands: five payload bytes; bytes 0..3 are context, byte 4 begins the continuation body
control_flow: returns the continuation body cursor or null when the table is absent

name: advance-script-choice
summary: Advances the script-choice counter and selects the next entry according to context mode 0, 1, or 2; mode 0 uses actor+68 as a deterministic index.
control_flow: updates current action tuple and continues

name: pick-highest-mask-lane
summary: Scans actor+2821 for set bits, stores the highest matching lane index, and sets the current action mode to 1/group 0.
writes: actor+2673 when not in gated state

name: pick-mask-lane-and-bind
summary: Scans actor+2687 (hate flags) for set bits, stores the highest matching lane both as current index and as actor+2612 (cmd_pl_target), and clears two continuation flags.

name: bind-current-lane
summary: Sets action mode 1/group 0 and uses actor+2612 (cmd_pl_target) as the current index, masking it to four bits unless it is -1.

name: angle-threshold gate
summary: Converts the payload byte to an angle threshold, computes the relative angle to the selected target context, and scans to the 0x14 body marker when the threshold is exceeded.
operands: selector plus u8 angle threshold in selector 0
control_flow: selector 0 performs a geometric gate; selector 1 is a marker continuation

name: area_match
summary: Matches actor+2040 against big-endian u16 area cases in source order, applying native map adaptation to both sides. First match wins; else is optional. DSL: match self.area.
operands: selector; selector 0 carries count and big-endian u16 ids
control_flow: selector 0 conditionally skips nested body; selector 1 repeatedly advances to 0x15 subtype 3

variants.summary: native skip prefix: count plus three-byte header; handler walks the id list

name: call_table9_subscript
summary: Calls root[9][index], storing the continuation in actor+2608 and the index in actor+2613. FF 03 restores that single cursor; neither instruction changes stage. Another 0x16 overwrites the saved continuation. DSL calls a function assigned to table 9.
control_flow: direct cursor replacement when the table exists; one saved return cursor, not a stack

name: set-target-context
summary: Initializes a four-byte target context only when actor+2844 (area-move counter) is unset; stores target mode, count, table selector, and context flags.
control_flow: linear; ignores the payload when a target context is already active

name: try_change_area
summary: When the area-route entry count is greater than one and the global gate allows it, selects a destination area, saves the continuation, and enters the configured root[6] script. DSL: self.try_change_area(); no result or immediate area-change guarantee.
control_flow: may replace the current cursor with the selected target script

name: copy-target-id-to-action
summary: Copies actor+3208 (maji_next_stage_no) into the current action tuple as mode 3/group/index and invokes the native no-op hook used by this path.

name: set-normalized-target-id
summary: Reads a big-endian u16 target id, normalizes it, and writes the normalized id to pending/current target and action-selection fields.

name: selection-byte equality gate
summary: Selector 0 compares payload byte 1 with actor+2681 (mind state b) and otherwise scans to a 0x1B marker; selector 1 is marker-aware.
control_flow: may skip nested instructions and decode subtype 2

name: deterministic-ratio branch
summary: Selector 0 computes a deterministic ratio from two native hash-like functions, compares it with a threshold list, and walks nested 0x1C body instructions. Selectors 1/2 are marker forms.
operands: selector; selector 0 carries count, header fields, and threshold/body entries
control_flow: conditional nested-body skip; selector 1/2 repeatedly advance to marker

variants.summary: native skip prefix; handler walks threshold/body entries

name: ordered-byte branch
summary: Selector 0 compares actor+2682 against an ordered byte list and skips nested 0x1D body instructions until the first matching/greater entry; selectors 1/2 are marker forms.
operands: selector; selector 0 carries count, header, and ordered byte entries

variants.summary: native skip prefix; handler walks ordered list

name: clear-behavior-requests
summary: Clears the accepted behavior request, its priority, five pending request flags, and three timer-request trigger latches. Target fields and timer values are unchanged.
domain_notes: +3188 = priority level of the currently granted command request; sub_10855BD0 offers 0x80/0x70/0x60/0x50/0x40 and sub_10855470 only accepts a value >= the stored one
+3189..3193 are pending flags, not a FIFO queue or request counts
+2735/+2736/+2737 suppress repeat requests from zero timers +2704/+2696/+2700; clearing these latches permits subsequent retriggering

name: flag-not-one gate
summary: Selector 0 continues only when actor+1040 (entity status byte) is not 1; otherwise it scans to a 0x1F marker. Selector 1 is marker-aware.

name: relative-angle threshold branch
summary: Selector 0 obtains a target position, computes a normalized relative angle against actor+164 (heading), and compares it with a list of thresholds before walking nested 0x20 body instructions.
control_flow: conditional nested-body skip; selector 1/2 are marker forms

variants.summary: native skip prefix; handler walks threshold/body entries

name: counter-threshold gate
summary: Selector 0 continues only when actor+2696 (hate accumulator 1) is greater than actor+2708 (hate accumulator 4) multiplied by a global scale; otherwise it scans to the 0x21 marker.

name: distance threshold gate
summary: Selector 0 compares the distance between the actor position and the stored reference point +2852/+2856/+2860 with a scaled threshold byte and skips nested body instructions when the distance exceeds it.
control_flow: conditional nested-body skip; selector 1 is marker continuation
domain_notes: +2852 = x of the stored reference point; sub_108625B0 computes (actor+172 - +2852, 0, actor+180 - +2860) and compares its length with the operand-scaled threshold

name: actor-kind list gate
summary: Selector 0 checks a list of actor kind bytes against up to 40 actor records, with a special 0xB1 kind gate, then walks nested 0x23 body instructions when no match is found.
operands: selector; selector 0 carries count and actor-kind list

variants.summary: native skip prefix; handler walks kind list

name: repeat-body counter
summary: Selector 0 stores a repeat count and body cursor; selector 1 decrements the count and returns to the body while it remains positive.
operands: selector; selector 0 carries u8 repeat count
control_flow: selector 1 can transfer the cursor back to the saved body; selector 0 scans to a 0x24 body marker when count is non-positive

name: reset-repeat-counter
summary: Clears actor+2623 (interpreter stop flag 2), the repeat counter used by opcode 0x24.

name: set-secondary-selection-byte
summary: Copies the payload byte into actor+2738.

name: ordered-runtime-byte branch
summary: Compares actor+27 (linked-actor pointer) against an ordered byte list and skips nested 0x27 body instructions based on the comparison result.
operands: selector; selector 0 carries count and ordered byte list

variants.summary: native skip prefix; handler walks ordered list

name: player-in-area gate
summary: Enters the body when some active player record shares the monster's raw area id at actor+2040, otherwise skips to else or end. No tracking, distance, line-of-sight, or map/day-night mapping is applied. DSL: self.has_player_in_area.

name: area_timer_expired
summary: Enters the body when signed i16 actor+2910 is <= 0; positive values skip to else or end. Checks an area-related countdown without waiting, resetting it or initiating an area change. DSL: self.area_timer_expired.

name: attack_timer_active
summary: Enters the body when signed i16 actor+2912 is positive; otherwise skips to else or end. The timer decreases in attack mode, but this condition does not check the current mode. DSL: self.attack_timer_active.

name: field-equality branch
summary: Selector 0 compares one of nine runtime fields/actor-kind combinations with a payload byte and skips nested 0x2B body instructions when unequal.
operands: selector, comparison byte; selector 0 chooses field family via payload byte

name: species-group branch
summary: Compares the normalized group key for actor species byte +3 with each case species through off_11A4E9C0, entering the first matching case; no match enters the optional fallback or ends the block.
operands: selector; selector 0 carries the case count, selector 1 carries a species ID
control_flow: ordered first-match branch with optional fallback
domain_notes: off_11A4E9C0 points to FF-terminated species groups; the opcode compares each group's first byte and preserves source order

name: copy-action-context-7
summary: Sets action mode 7 and copies actor+2922 (two-state byte a)/B6B into the current action group/index fields.

name: select-context-table
summary: Recomputes actor+1968 from the actor kind and an operand byte; special actor kinds select different context-table offsets and mode values.

name: any_player_carrying
summary: Enters the body if any configured player's carry-state low nibble is nonzero, otherwise skips to else or end. No area, distance, target or item-category check. DSL: context.any_player_carrying.

name: mark-available-lane
summary: Finds the first configured lane with a nonzero low-nibble availability flag and sets actor+3190 to 1.
control_flow: linear; returns a packed value containing the lane index and actor pointer in native registers
writes: actor+3190=1 when a lane is found

name: set-action-mode-8
summary: Sets the current action mode byte to 8.

name: selection-byte equality gate
summary: Selector 0 compares actor+2088 (byte stored by 0x0a) with a payload byte and walks nested 0x32 body instructions when unequal.

name: selection-byte list gate
summary: Selector 0 compares actor+2088 (byte stored by 0x0a) against a payload list and walks nested 0x33 body instructions until a match is found.
operands: selector; selector 0 carries count and byte list

variants.summary: native skip prefix; handler walks list

name: actor-kind-pair gate
summary: Selector 0 compares actor bytes +20 and +21 against two payload bytes and walks nested 0x34 body instructions when either differs.

name: rage-active condition
summary: Selector 0 executes the body when the rage flag at actor+2726 is nonzero; otherwise it scans nested 0x35 blocks to else/end.

name: distance threshold gate
summary: Selector 0 computes distance between the actor position (+172/+180) and the stored reference point (+2852/+2860) and walks nested 0x36 body instructions when distance is greater than the scaled payload threshold.
domain_notes: +2852 = x of the stored reference point; sub_10862700 uses the same (x,z) distance form as 0x22

name: global-flag gate
summary: Selector 0 continues only when global object flags +44 do not contain bit 0x200000; otherwise it walks nested 0x37 body instructions.

name: species-variant table gate
summary: Selector 0 reads a table entry indexed by actor species id +2040 and actor variant +2008; a nonzero table byte suppresses the nested 0x38 body.

name: flash-active condition
summary: Selector 0 executes the body when the flash timer at actor+2914 is nonzero; otherwise it scans nested 0x39 blocks to else/end.

name: nonzero-selection gate
summary: Selector 0 continues only when actor+3186 is nonzero; otherwise it walks nested 0x3A body instructions.

name: null-pointer gate
summary: Selector 0 continues only when actor+3172 (linked-actor pointer) is null; otherwise it walks nested 0x3B body instructions.
domain_notes: +3172 = linked-actor pointer; sub_108578A0 scans the 3824-byte record array dword_1ED7AD2C (40 entries) for a record whose +3 equals a per-species constant and stores it here, 0 = none

name: other-actor gate
summary: Selector 0 suppresses the nested body only when actor+3172 (linked-actor pointer) points to an actor whose mode +2680 equals 1 and the same species id.
domain_notes: +3172 = linked-actor pointer set by sub_108578A0 (array dword_1ED7AD2C, stride 3824, 40 entries), 0 = none

name: normalized-target-id gate
summary: Selector 0 compares a big-endian payload id, normalized through 0x10B4C5E0, with actor+2846 (saved motion id) and walks nested 0x3D body instructions when unequal.

name: normalized-target-id list gate
summary: Selector 0 reads a count and big-endian target-id list, normalizes each id, and walks nested 0x3E body instructions until a match. Selectors 1..3 are marker forms.
operands: selector; selector 0 carries count and big-endian u16 ids

variants.summary: native skip prefix; handler walks id list

name: select-nearest-target-script
summary: Reads a big-endian target id and radius byte, resolves the target table, chooses a matching or nearest sub-entry, and loads the selected script context and cursor.
operands: big-endian u16 target id, u8 radius/threshold
control_flow: returns the selected script cursor; may set actor+3183 when no entry is available

variants.summary: opcode plus big-endian u16 and radius byte
